question: The World Sustainable Development Summit 2025 took place in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS) is an annual flagship event organized by **The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI)**.
 
• The WSDS 2025 took place in **New Delhi, India**, continuing the tradition of addressing critical global sustainability challenges.
 
• The summit serves as a platform for global leaders, policymakers, and researchers to deliberate on sustainable development goals and climate action strategies.
 
• The WSDS focuses on themes such as renewable energy, climate resilience, and equitable economic growth, aligning with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
 
• The event is supported by the Government of India and various international organizations, showcasing India's commitment to sustainability leadership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI):**

 
 
• TERI is a leading research institute headquartered in New Delhi, focusing on energy, environment, and sustainable development.
 
• It was established in 1974 and has been organizing the WSDS since 2001 (formerly known as the Delhi Sustainable Development Summit).
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• A global framework adopted by the United Nations in 2015, comprising 17 goals aimed at eradicating poverty, protecting the planet, and ensuring peace and prosperity by 2030.
 
• WSDS aligns its discussions with key SDGs, such as Climate Action (Goal 13) and Affordable and Clean Energy (Goal 7).
 
 
 
• **India's Role in Global Sustainability:**
 
 
• India has been an active participant in global climate forums such as COP (Conference of Parties) and is a signatory to the Paris Agreement.
 
• The WSDS reinforces India's position as a leader in climate resilience and sustainable development initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Key Highlights of WSDS 2025:**
 
 
• Discussions on scaling up renewable energy adoption, combating climate change, and fostering green economic recovery post-pandemic.
 
• Participation from global leaders, including heads of state, Nobel laureates, and sustainability experts.
